notes.title: Major Update: Content Notes August 2025
notes.content:
[b]Major Update for Ailuri
August 2025[/b]

Hey everyone, it has been a while. 
We've been working hard on features in response to all of the feedback we received on launch. This major update includes art changes, crucial bug fixes and some QOL upgrades. These include:

- Rescue Danger Zones have been revamped, with new areas that act similar to a miniboss room and art updates. All Rescue Danger Zones, except a couple of unique rooms, have a new Door to signal to the player that an Animal needs rescuing up ahead. This also comes with enemy rebalances and platforming updates.

- Visual Updates to most levels and art. This includes level adjustments, overhauls of sprites and rebalancing of some of the collectables. Starting Checkpoints now have unique stones and mechanics overall have updated art for better optimization and higher quality appearance.

- UI updates with new animations and text fixes. This also comes with QOL changes such as the option to start from the previously saved Checkpoint, which was a major request from players. Other updates include UI Collectable counters on the Pause Menu so players can determine properly how many Collectables are missing in their collection. 

- New Enemies. Our first batch of new enemies have been added to the game. You can find them in the Rescue Danger Zones.

- New Animated Cutscenes added in the boss sequences. This is the first batch of cutscenes added to the game for more story clarity. Fixes to some existing cutscenes have also been applied.

We hope you all enjoy these new features and major update. We'll keep an eye out for more bugs and will continue patching them throughout the week.

notes.title: Update Notes for 17 Feb
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

We have been working on more patches and gameplay QOL updates these past few days. We will continue to work on feedback and bug reports. 

[list]
[*] Checkpoints now heal and revive anytime a Player walks over them.
[*] Added a UI prompt checkbox for restarting levels.
[*] Fixes to the cameras when respawning.
[*] Dash Attack fixed with updated invincibility frames, VFX and knockback when hitting enemies.
[*] Forest Boss now no longer gets pushed aside when getting hit.
[*] Various art updates and level fixes.
[*] Forest Map's Rescue zones have been slightly revamped and re-balanced.
[*] Enemies that have shields/armor have updated art to reflect this. 
[/list]

We have further content updates planned later on. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Notes for 13 Feb
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we worked on some more patches and fixes.

[list]
[*] Reworked and fixed some issues in the final Map
[*] Updated Ailuri's attack detection and some enemy combat balancing
[*] Some enemies have new animations and VFX
[*] Checkpoints now glow every time you walk over one to display saving
[*] Visual text prompt whenever the player rescues an animal and it goes to your Sanctuary
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

As previously mentioned, we're working on UI overhaul and some combat fixes. We also see feedback on storytelling, so we'll be adding more visual storytelling in the game to clarify what's happening. There are animated cutscenes throughout the game during important story beats, but it may not be enough to demonstrate what is going on. We'll work on this. 

We encourage feedback and discussion in the threads of our updates! 

Cheers!

notes.title: Update Notes for 12 Feb
notes.content:
We've made our first of the larger patches to the game after receiving feedback and reports over the past few days. 

[list]
[*] Some fixes to camera bugs across multiple levels.
[*] Sanctuary has a major visual update with the Music Stones now correctly changing the backgrounds.
[*] Level design patches, changes and fixes.
[*] Some enemies are getting updated animations and attack hit boxes for a better gameplay experience.
[*] Heal Abilities have new VFX
[*] Cleaner UI and some bug fixes on UI mapping. 
[*] Other various bug fixes.
[/list]
We'll continue to monitor and update the game in response to feedback, so any feedback is appreciated. There is a plan to have a visual overhaul of the UI and there will be some more updates to combat in the coming updates. 

Cheers!

notes.title: Update Notes for 8 Feb
notes.content:
Hi everyone, thank you all for the great response to Ailuri's release!

We have patched a number of issues that were brought up during our launch. This includes fixing the background music not playing consistently as well as adjusting the codec for the cutscenes to better suit the SteamDeck. 
The credit sequence has been corrected, too.

We are always open to work on feedback and bug reports. Cheers!
